title: Astro Portal session event payload: plan_edited
description: The plan of the night was changed while the session ran: a target added, removed or moved, with the slots the change gave them. One event per applied change (a single add from the « + » of the list, the undo of that add, or the whole of an « Édition de la nuit » once validated), so the debriefing reads « Prévu 02:54 → 03:54 » for a target put in the plan during the night and the new hours of the targets that moved, instead of calling a target that IS in the plan « Ajoutée sur le terrain ». Slots are minutes counted from the start of the night of the plan (`plan.items[].startMinute` / `endMinute` of planner-document.schema.json), the same unit the plan uses. At least one of `added`, `removed`, `moved` is present and non-empty. Written by the application at the instant of the change (the night's clock); every field but the lists is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Not private in a shared night: the plan is shared. See session-events.md.

origin.description: Optional: how the change was made — `add` the single add of the list's « + », `undo` the person took that add back, `edit` the « Édition de la nuit » mode once validated (any number of changes together).

added.description: The targets that were not in the plan and now are, each with its slot.

removed.description: The targets that were in the plan and no longer are in tonight's plan, or that the change left with no time tonight (`noTimeTonight: true`: still a line of the plan, covered by another target).

noTimeTonight.description: `true` when the target stays a line of the plan with no time tonight (another target took its slot); absent when it left the plan.

moved.description: The targets that stay in the plan with another slot: where they were (`fromStartMinute`, `fromEndMinute`) and where they are now.
